tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: The brand green, taken from the logo. Fills, marks, highlights and large accent blocks. Never text on `surface` in Light (1.7:1): use `link` there. As text it reads on `surface` in Dark (12.5:1).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `brand-green` fill, both themes (11.6:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. White and black are the two logo grounds.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on `surface` (19.4:1 Light, 18.8:1 Dark). Same ink as the logo wordmark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on `surface` (7.5:1 Light, 8.6:1 Dark). Proposed: not in the logo files.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and inline accent text on `surface` (5.0:1 Light; `brand-green` in Dark, 12.5:1). Proposed: a darkened brand green, because the logo green is too light for text on white.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on `surface` (5.0:1 Light, 12.5:1 Dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and table rules on `surface`. Decorative only. Control borders use `ink-muted`. Proposed.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Passed, protected, met. Text, icons and 1px rules on `surface` (6.2:1 Light, 10.9:1 Dark) and on `status-success-fill` (5.3:1, 7.9:1). A teal-leaning green so it never reads as `brand-green`. Always paired with a word; never colour alone.

tokens.name: status-success-fill
tokens.usage: Background behind a success label, row or banner. Put `status-success` or `ink` on it (ink 16.7:1 Light, 13.7:1 Dark). Not a decorative tint.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention: review required, unstable, few samples. Text, icons and rules on `surface` (6.8:1 Light, 10.8:1 Dark) and on `status-warning-fill` (6.0:1, 8.2:1). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-warning-fill
tokens.usage: Background behind a warning label, row or banner. Put `status-warning` or `ink` on it (ink 17.0:1 Light, 14.3:1 Dark).

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Failed, missed, exposed, blocking. Text, icons and rules on `surface` (6.5:1 Light, 8.3:1 Dark) and on `status-danger-fill` (5.4:1, 6.7:1). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-danger-fill
tokens.usage: Background behind a danger label, row or banner. Put `status-danger` or `ink` on it (ink 16.1:1 Light, 15.0:1 Dark).

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Neutral news that is not a verdict: new, changed, candidate evidence. Text, icons and rules on `surface` (6.5:1 Light, 9.6:1 Dark) and on `status-info-fill` (5.4:1, 7.7:1). Not a second link colour.

tokens.name: status-info-fill
tokens.usage: Background behind an info label, row or banner. Put `status-info` or `ink` on it (ink 16.3:1 Light, 15.0:1 Dark).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Montserrat ExtraBold, the weight of the logo wordmark. Headings are set in sentence case. Reserve uppercase for the logo and `eyebrow`.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Keep secrets out of your code
styles.usage: Hero headlines on landing and product pages. One per page.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles in docs and the benchmark app.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a heading, in `ink` or `link`. Write the text in capitals.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Montserrat Regular and SemiBold for reading text.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Redact Secret finds and masks credentials before they leave your machine.
styles.usage: Default reading text in docs and the product pages.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy, and button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, table cells and metadata, usually in `ink-muted`.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Proposed: the logo files don't define spacing.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, and the vertical padding in buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between related controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding in buttons and inputs, and card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, and gaps between paragraphs and blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gaps between major page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero and page-edge padding on desktop.

radius.note: Sharp corners, to match the angular triangle mark. Proposed.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default: blocks, cards, images, banners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and tooltips. Nothing rounder.
